deviations.what: The code truncates cpc_subclass to its first three characters with substr(cpc_subclass, 1, 3), so a four-character CPC subclass such as H04L becomes the class-level code H04; the class used in rules 4, 5 and 7 is therefore coarser than the subclass the spec defines.

notes: All other rules match: filing_year dating, the cpc_seq == 0 filter with the first_listed_only switch, blank and missing class exclusion, base offsets 1 to 5 and forward offsets 1 to 3 so year t is excluded, the anti-join for new classes, NA when the base is empty, 0 when the forward set is empty, firm-level grouping, and one row per distinct firm_year with the specified columns. The 1987-2015 focal-year default is not enforced in the function; it takes its years from firm_year as rule 11 requires, so I did not count that as a deviation.
